prompt: what are microplastics and should i worry
reply:
They are plastic worn into fragments smaller than a grain of rice — from bottles breaking up, from tyres, from washing synthetic clothes. Researchers have found them in ocean water, in soil, in rain and in human blood samples. What they do inside a body is still being studied, so anyone certain either way is ahead of the evidence. Worth watching, not worth panicking about. 🔬
[FACT]Washing synthetic clothes sheds plastic fibres into the water.[/FACT]
